# ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io Daily Update (Feb 3, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on documentation improvements, including adding missing supported chains to the README and creating a CONTRIBUTING.md file. A duplicate token entry was also removed.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Documentation and Contribution Guidelines
- Added nine missing supported chains (unichain, unichain-sepolia, soneium, soneium-minato, swellchain, ink, ink-sepolia, worldchain, worldchain-sepolia) to the README documentation ([#1268](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1268)).
- Introduced a new `CONTRIBUTING.md` file to provide guidelines for contributors ([#1274](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1274)).

### Token List Refinement
- Removed a duplicate 'LDO' entry from the default tokens list in `src/defaultTokens.ts` ([#1273](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1273)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#1272](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1272) Fix subject-pronoun agreement in README
- [#1271](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1271) Fix CircleCI config grammar and formatting issues
- [#1270](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1270) Add missing chains to L2_TO_L1_PAIR mapping
- [#1269](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1269) Add missing chains to schema validation anyOf array
- [#1267](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1267) Fix missing space before parenthetical in README
- [#1266](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1266) Add XAN token

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Resolution of L1 Polling Issue in op-supernode
- The issue where HTTP L1 URLs caused disabled polling and prevented virtual nodes from receiving L1 head updates in `op-supernode` has been closed, resolved by pull request #18970 ([#19012](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19012)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Supernode Data Retrieval Challenges
- A new issue has been opened regarding `op-supernode`'s inability to fetch super roots via `atTimestamp` if no verified or safe data exists at the referenced timestamp. The discussion is ongoing about whether `supernode` should return super roots even for unsafe data, and the implications for verification ([#19059](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19059)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-node: Initial EL Sync UX and Correctness
Discussion continues on the behavior of `op-node` marking the target of initial EL Sync as finalized, even if the block is not actually finalized ([#17631](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/17631)).
- **trianglesphere** clarified that snap sync only works if the state snapshot is available and geth only stores snapshots for 128 blocks from its tip, implying that for snap sync, one must sync to the unsafe head.
- **axelKingsley** argued that EL sync should only be used for finalized content, and snap sync targets after finalization are subject to being incorrect. They suggested making snap sync follow the finalized L2 as a maximum target.
- **sebastianst** agreed that the current behavior is buggy and proposed running derivation from a prior L1 block and then consolidation to verify alignment with the EL-synced unsafe chain. They also suggested fixing the code to only advance the unsafe ref while keeping safe and finalized at genesis.

### Enable skipped acceptance tests for interop proofs
The issue of enabling skipped acceptance tests for interop proofs is still active, with recent comments indicating that some tests remain skipped despite the issue being closed and reopened ([#18616](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18616)).
- **ajsutton** reopened the issue, noting that a `TODO/skip` referencing it still exists in `op-acceptance-tests/tests/isthmus/preinterop/interop_readiness_test.go:106`, specifically `TestInteropReadiness`. This test needs to be unskipped once the super DG supports explicit output roots.
- **Inphi** acknowledged that the issue was moved to the backlog but GitHub still closed it due to its link to a PR.
- **ajsutton** re-closed the issue to test a TODO checker AI skill, hoping it would tag him.
